summary: All 26 genes labeled in Hahn et al. Figure 2B matched the registered direction of change in hypothalamus at 21 versus 3 months (19 up, 7 down). The recovered Table S1 reports age correlations and gene signatures, while Figure 2B supplies a direction-only reference for these selected genes. Exact author coefficients, endpoint P values and FDR remain unassessed.

manualReview.summary: All 26 displayed hypothalamic age-effect directions agreed
manualReview.note: The Figure 2B heat map and the authors’ plotting code identify the sex-adjusted hypothalamus 21-minus-3-month comparison. All labeled rows joined by exact mouse gene symbol. Their directions agreed across the journal and preprint images and with the registered edgeR-QL output. GEO counts and series metadata also match their recorded checksums.
reviewFlags: The panel shows 26 author-selected genes out of 13,518 registered genes. Its size falls below the 30-pair minimum in author-concordance-v2.
The figure provides color-coded effects. Exact author coefficients, raw P, adjusted P and the full list of tested genes for this contrast were unavailable.
The authors fit DESeq2 across all ages. HypoExplorer fits edgeR-QL to the two endpoint groups. Both fits include sex.

evidenceLinks.label: Hahn et al., manuscript and Figure 2

verificationReview.reason: All 26 displayed Figure 2B directions agreed. Both methods estimate the 21-minus-3-month hypothalamic age effect with sex adjustment. DESeq2 uses the multi-age cohort and edgeR-QL uses the endpoint animals. Table S1 is accessible, but its hypothalamic correlations and P values summarize age across time points. The figure gives no endpoint P or FDR.
verificationReview.nextStep: For a full numerical comparison, obtain the authors’ results_list_CA1$Both$hy[['21_vs_3']]$resall output with symbols, log2 fold changes, raw P and adjusted P, including rows with missing tests.

comparabilityReview.basis: Direct comparison of the sign of each labeled hypothalamic Figure 2B cell with the sign of the corresponding registered edgeR-QL logFC. Every displayed row was included.
comparabilityReview.reference: Hahn et al., Cell Figure 2B, checked against the losslessly embedded bioRxiv v1 and v3 figures. Rscripts/01 and /07 in the authors’ pinned repository establish the model, contrast, age order and palette. Table S1 was inspected separately.

cohort.note: GEO and the authors’ metadata identify the same 9 young and 11 aged mice used by the registry. At 3 months there are 4 males and 5 females, and at 21 months there are 6 males and 5 females. The authors fit all 55 hypothalamic samples across ages.

contrast.note: Both sexes, hypothalamus, 21 months minus 3 months, adjusted for sex. In script 07 the comparisons against 3 months are ordered 12, 15, 18, 21, 26 and 28 months with column clustering disabled.

features.note: All 26 distinct plotted mouse symbols joined a unique registered row by exact symbol. No aliases, duplicates or unmatched labels entered the comparison.

effects.note: The authors plot DESeq2 log2 fold changes. All 19 positive and 7 negative color-coded effects had the same sign in the registered edgeR-QL table. Effect magnitudes, Pearson and Spearman were unassessed because the figure bins the coefficients into colors.

inference.note: The panel does not give gene-level P values or FDR for the 21-versus-3 coefficient. Of the 26 registered rows, 23 had FDR < 0.05. Author discovery counts and shared discovery counts remain unknown.

coverage.note: All 26 labeled rows contributed nonzero directions, covering the displayed panel and 26 of 13,518 registered genes. The authors selected genes for cross-region aging patterns. Table S1 and the checked public repository did not supply a full 21-versus-3-month hypothalamic result.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use the labeled hypothalamus column and the age order in the authors’ code. Read the sign of each cell without filtering by significance or estimating coefficients from color. Under author-concordance-v2, both numerical routes require at least 30 pairs and compatible definitions and coverage. The direction route additionally requires at least 30 nonzero pairs. This panel has 26.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Direction agreed across the complete displayed set. This closes a selected-gene comparison only. A v2 acceptance decision, exact magnitude agreement, inferential agreement and full-contrast verification cannot be supported from this panel.

computed.claim: Figure 2B rows joined by exact symbol, with nonzero directions on both sides
Directional agreement in the displayed panel
Registered coverage and local discovery context
computed.value: 26/13,518 registered genes; local FDR < 0.05 for 23/26 displayed genes and 625/13,518 overall; no author endpoint P or FDR assessed

computed.claim: Hypothalamic cohort membership verified against the GEO records and author metadata
computed.value: 9 at 3 months and 11 at 21 months; all 20 endpoint animals matched. The all-age author metadata contains 55 hypothalamic samples.
15 worksheets. The age-correlation sheet contains 277 hypothalamus rows with Spearman coefficients, not endpoint log2 fold changes.

openIssues: A full numerical comparison requires the authors’ sex-adjusted hypothalamus 21-versus-3 result table, including missing tests. Exact coefficient magnitudes, P values, FDR and agreement outside the 26 displayed genes remain unassessed.
